Title: REINVENT 4 Mol2MolMediumSimilarity
Description: Produces up to 100 novel structures of moderate similarity to a query molecule, populating the space around a starting point without straying far from it. A similarity-trained Mol2Mol prior from REINVENT 4 drives the generation, one of several transformer priors in an open framework that also supports linker design, scaffold hopping and R-group replacement. The prior is sampled at random, so repeated runs return different sets; sampling is repeated up to a limit until 100 distinct structures are collected. The query and its stereoisomers are discarded.
Interpretation: Up to 100 sampled molecules of moderate structural similarity to the input compound, listed from most to least similar (Morgan Tanimoto); sets differ between runs.
